title: SimFuse3D: Source-Guided Target Simulation and Confidence-Guided Multi-Stage Localization Reweighting for Cross-Platform 3D Object Detection
abstract: arXiv:2609.04886v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Changes in sensor height and viewpoint alter object-level point distributions, making cross-platform LiDAR unsupervised domain adaptation (UDA) difficult. Self-training uses labeled source scans and unlabeled target scans, yet a retained prediction may provide a useful target location while enclosing sparse foreground returns, background clutter, or points inconsistent with the predicted box. We refer to this mismatch as box-point inconsistency. We introduce SimFuse3D, which preserves the target placement and repairs the associated pseudo-object using measured geometry from labeled source scans. Object Memory retrieves a compatible labeled source instance. Target Simulation places its ground-truth box at the target location, aligns its points with the target viewing geometry, and filters the aligned crop to approximate the target observation. translated_title: SimFuse3D：面向跨平台3D目标检测的源引导目标仿真与置信度引导多阶段定位重加权
translated_abstract: 传感器高度和视点的变化会改变目标级别的点分布，这使得跨平台LiDAR的无监督域适应（UDA）变得困难。自训练方法使用带标注的源扫描和未标注的目标扫描，然而被保留的预测框虽然可能提供了有用的目标位置，但框内却可能包含稀疏的前景点、背景杂乱点或与预测框不一致的点。我们将这种不匹配称为“框-点不一致性”。我们提出了SimFuse3D，它保留目标位置的同时，利用来自带标注源扫描的真实几何信息来修复相应的伪目标。对象记忆库检索相匹配的带标注源实例；目标仿真将该真实标注框放置到目标位置，将其点云对齐到目标观测几何，并对对齐后的裁剪区域进行过滤以逼近目标观测效果；置信度引导多阶段定位重加权（CMLR）则为每个目标伪目标……
tldr: SimFuse3D通过利用带标注源数据的真实几何信息来修复目标伪对象的框-点不一致问题，并结合置信度引导的多阶段定位重加权策略，提升了跨平台LiDAR无监督域适应3D目标检测的性能。
en_tdlr: SimFuse3D addresses the box-point inconsistency in cross-platform LiDAR unsupervised domain adaptation by repairing target pseudo-objects with source ground-truth geometry and applying confidence-guided multi-stage localization reweighting.
